config.name: move_census_chain
config._purpose: EXACT, exploratory. The move census of configs/move_census.json rerun with the corrected script, which enumerates only the switches the chain can propose (two points of side 0 swap one partner each). The first run also counted switches between opposite sides, which the chain never makes and is_valid does not refuse. Same arrangements, same melt, same seed, so the two files compare row by row (ASSUMPTIONS O20, correction to the addendum).
